title: Amateur Ow, Ers
description: Amateur Ow, Ers — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the All-Amateur Assault off Level 3 of MutantMania. Assaultize against Unika the Unusual and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the All-Amateur Assault off Level 3 of MutantMania. Assaultize against Unika the Unusual and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

As your self-appointed fight manager, Ah'm responsible for your semi-professional success. To build your skills in preparation for the big leagues, Ah need you to go to the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3 and fight Unika the Unusual. He's no Manglefeet, but he's a good sparring partner for you.

Turn-in:

Friend, you have quite a swelling hematoma. Bruise, that is. Ah had a chat with Unika the Unusual recently. Apparently, you're doing better in the polyhedral circle than before, but you need some more practice. Come back to me when your hematoma stops swelling.

Objectives:

  • Assaultilize Unika the Unusual

Level range: 81–91
